Reserve the right edge for deadlines... because scheduling is the proposed Monday-review priority'). It also changes keyboard use ('drop keyboard dependence') and gives a reason for each trait it keeps.

The agent viewed .../desk/captures/home.png and ran sips on captures/home.png before presenting it.
The reply says "Not presentation-ready" and names "a red block, and a bottom row cut off by a blank panel," which matches the red status chip and the white box over the bottom of the list.

The agent did not rely only on viewing files or screenshots. It settled the task count and chip colours with the Python script and the browser eval comparisons.

The reply says "agreed layout decisions become checks run after every edit."
